-- Purpose: number of signups per plan for users created in March 2026, largest first, top 10

    SELECT
        p,
        COUNT(*) AS signups_cnt
    FROM analytics.users AS u
    JOIN analytics.plans AS p ON u.plan = p.id
    WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND u.created_at >= '2026-03-01'
      AND u.created_at < '2026-04-01'

)
SELECT
    p,
    signups_cnt
FROM base
ORDER BY signups_cnt DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Purpose: Average order amount per sales channel for orders created in Q1 2026, top 15
-- Owner: revenue-ops

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        channel,
        amount,
        created_at
    FROM
        analytics.orders
    WHERE
        deleted_at IS NULL
        AND created_at >= '2026-01-01'
        AND created_at < '2026-04-01'
)

SELECT
    channel,
    ROUND(AVG(amount)_avg, 2) as avg_amount
FROM
    base
GROUP BY
    channel
ORDER BY
    avg_amount DESC
LIMIT
    15;
